description: This file defines a React functional component named VideoGrid, which displays a grid or list of videos with thumbnails, titles, channels, and view counts. It handles the case where there are no videos to display and allows selecting a video via an onSelect callback.

methods.name: VideoGrid({ videos, onSelect })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a grid of video items, each with thumbnail, title, channel, and views. Handles no videos case and click events for selection.
